name: OCS Job Hider
description: Enhance your OCS job application management with smart hiding, color-coding, and organization features. Hide applications you've already processed, mark jobs to apply, and get visual status indicators. Automatically color-codes applications by status (green for shortlisted, yellow for to-apply, etc.) and organizes hidden applications in a collapsible section. Works on Firefox Desktop and Mobile with sync support.
author: Someone From iitd
